launchRedesign.selectBusinessFirst.en: Choose the assigned Business Center to see its ad accounts.
launchRedesign.selectBusinessFirst.zh: 先选择已分配的商务中心，再查看其中的广告账户。

launchRedesign.uniqueExplainer.en: Unique: each campaign receives its own codes, handed out in pasted order.
launchRedesign.uniqueExplainer.zh: 独立使用：每个广告活动按粘贴顺序分配不同的授权码。

launchRedesign.sharedExplainer.en: Shared: the same set of codes is reused by every campaign and account.
launchRedesign.sharedExplainer.zh: 共用：每个广告活动和账户重复使用同一组授权码。

launchRedesign.sparkCount.zh: Spark 授权码已提供／所需

launchRedesign.countFormula.zh: 每个广告活动 {perCampaign} 个 · {accounts} 个账户共 {campaigns} 个广告活动 · {mode}

launchRedesign.chooseAccounts.zh: 选择广告账户 · 已选 {selected}／{available} 个

launchRedesign.sparksPerCampaign.zh: 每个广告活动的 Spark 授权码

launchRedesign.uniqueMath.en: {campaignsPerAccount} campaigns × {perCampaign} Sparks = {perAccount} unique codes per account; {total} total across {accounts} accounts.
launchRedesign.uniqueMath.zh: 每个账户 {campaignsPerAccount} 个广告活动 × 每活动 {perCampaign} 个 Spark 授权码 = 每账户 {perAccount} 个独立授权码；{accounts} 个账户共需 {total} 个。

launchRedesign.sharedMath.en: {perCampaign} codes reused in each of {campaigns} campaigns across all accounts.
launchRedesign.sharedMath.zh: {perCampaign} 个授权码在所有账户的 {campaigns} 个广告活动中重复使用。

launchRedesign.templatesSub.en: Reusable targeting and delivery settings for TikTok launches.
launchRedesign.templatesSub.zh: 为 TikTok 投放复用定向和投放设置。

launchRedesign.selectPortfolioFirst.en: Choose the assigned business portfolio to see its ad accounts.
launchRedesign.selectPortfolioFirst.zh: 先选择已分配的业务资产组合，再查看其中的广告账户。

launchRedesign.metaUniqueExplainer.en: Unique: each campaign receives its own selected posts or finished clips.
launchRedesign.metaUniqueExplainer.zh: 独立使用：每个广告活动分配不同的帖子或成品切片。

launchRedesign.metaSharedExplainer.en: Shared: the same selected posts or finished clips are reused by every campaign and account.
launchRedesign.metaSharedExplainer.zh: 共用：每个广告活动和账户重复使用同一组帖子或成品切片。

launchRedesign.metaUniqueMath.en: {campaignsPerAccount} campaigns × {perCampaign} creatives = {perAccount} unique creatives per account; {total} total across {accounts} accounts.
launchRedesign.metaUniqueMath.zh: 每个账户 {campaignsPerAccount} 个广告活动 × 每活动 {perCampaign} 个素材 = 每账户 {perAccount} 个独立素材；{accounts} 个账户共需 {total} 个。

launchRedesign.metaSharedMath.en: {perCampaign} creatives reused in each of {campaigns} campaigns across all accounts.
launchRedesign.metaSharedMath.zh: {perCampaign} 个素材在所有账户的 {campaigns} 个广告活动中重复使用。
